metadata.description: A curated collection of Claude Code plugins to supercharge your AI development workflow

plugins.name: skill-issue
plugins.description: Diagnose and improve your Claude Code effectiveness. Analyzes your interaction logs and project configuration to identify skill gaps and setup improvements.

plugins.name: security-review
plugins.description: Deep, agent-team-driven security review of one or more codebases. Coordinates a 14-agent team over a 7-phase workflow with adversarial verification and exploit-chain composition. Designed for Opus 4.7 with the 1M context window. Resumable; produces a vulnerability report with CVSS v3.1 scores and per-finding human verification test plans.
